createPin.name: createPin
createPin.description: Upload an image or video to create a new Pin on a board.

title.description: The title of the Pin (max 100 characters).

description.description: The description of the Pin (max 800 characters).

media_source_type.description: The type of media source for the Pin.

media_url.description: The URL of the image or video to upload. Must be a valid URL.

link.description: The destination URL that the Pin will link to when clicked.

dominant_color.description: The dominant color of the Pin as a hex color code (e.g., "#6E7874").

alt_text.description: Alternative text for accessibility and screen readers (max 500 characters).

parent_pin_id.description: The ID of the original Pin if this is a saved/repinned Pin.

sponsor_id.description: The sponsor account ID for paid partnership content. Available only to select users in closed beta.

note.description: A private note for this Pin that only you can see.

is_removable.description: Set to true to create an ad-only Pin that can be easily removed.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a Pin on a Pinterest board by uploading media from a hosted image/video URL (or base64 image). Use to publish visual content to a board the user owns. Requires a valid board_id and a media source; each call creates a new Pin, so it is not idempotent.

createBoard.name: createBoard
createBoard.description: Create a new Pinterest board for organizing Pins.

name.description: The name of the board (max 180 characters).

privacy.description: Board privacy setting (auto-set to "PROTECTED" for ad-only boards).

is_ads_only.description: Create an ad-only board that can only store promotional Pins. Note: Board name will become "Ad-only Pins" and privacy will be set to "PROTECTED".

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Pinterest board to organize Pins, with a name and optional description and privacy level. Use before adding Pins when no suitable board exists. Each call creates a separate board even with identical input, so it is not idempotent.

Permanently deletes a single Pin identified by its pin_id. Use to remove published content from Pinterest; this is destructive and cannot be undone. Repeating the call after the Pin is gone returns an error rather than re-deleting, so treat it as not idempotent.

findBoardByName.name: findBoardByName
findBoardByName.description: Search for boards by name using Pinterest's search API.

query.description: The search term to find boards (required).

aiMetadata.description: Searches the authenticated account's boards by a text query and returns matching boards. Use to resolve a board name into a board_id before creating Pins or updating a board. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination via a bookmark token.

findPin.name: findPin
findPin.description: Search for Pins using title, description, or keywords.

query.description: Search terms for pin titles, descriptions, or tags. You can also search using comma-separated pin IDs.

bookmark.description: Bookmark token from previous search results for pagination.

max_results.description: Maximum number of pins to return (useful for large result sets).

aiMetadata.description: Searches the authenticated account's Pins by keywords matched against title, description, or tags (comma-separated pin IDs also work). Use to locate existing Pins or resolve a pin_id before deleting or referencing one. Read-only and idempotent; supports a max-results cap and pagination via a bookmark token.

updateBoard.name: updateBoard
updateBoard.description: Update a board's name, description, or privacy settings.

name.description: The new name of the board (max 180 characters). Leave empty to keep current name.

description.description: The new description of the board (max 500 characters). Leave empty to keep current description.

privacy.description: Update board privacy setting. Leave empty to keep current setting.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing board's name, description, and/or privacy setting, identified by board_id. Use to rename or reconfigure a board the user owns; at least one field must be supplied. Mutates the board on each call, so it is not idempotent.

newBoard.name: newBoard
newBoard.description: Fires when a new board is created in the account.

page_size.description: Number of boards to fetch per page (1-250, default: 25).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new board is created in the authenticated Pinterest account, emitting the board record. Polls the account's boards and detects ones created since the last check, optionally filtered by privacy.

newFollower.name: newFollower
newFollower.description: Triggers when a user gains a new follower.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when the authenticated Pinterest account gains a new follower, emitting the follower's account info. Polls the account's followers list and emits entries not seen before.

newPinOnBoard.name: newPinOnBoard
newPinOnBoard.description: Fires when a new Pin is added to a specific board.

creative_types.description: Filter by specific pin types. Leave empty to watch all types.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new Pin is added to a specific board (selected by board_id), emitting the Pin record. Polls that board for Pins created since the last check, optionally filtered by creative type (regular, video, shopping, carousel, idea).
